metadata.title: Infrastructure & Trades: Physical World Standards
metadata.notes: Essential certifications for building and maintaining physical infrastructure.

nodes.title: AWS Certified Welder (Structural)
nodes.description: Fundamental welding techniques: Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW). Safety, equipment setup, and weld quality. Linked to the Foundry track.

nodes.title: EPA Section 608 Technician Certification
nodes.description: Safe handling and recovery of refrigerants. High-pressure and low-pressure system maintenance. Essential for building climate stewardship.

nodes.title: NCCER Plumbing Level 1
nodes.description: Plumbing tools, math, drawings, and plastic/copper/steel pipe installation. Linked to the Water Sovereignty and Greywater tracks.

nodes.title: NCCER Heavy Equipment Operations Level 1
nodes.description: Equipment safety, identification, and basic operation for loaders, backhoes, and dozers. Linked to the Subterranean and Terra tracks.

nodes.title: OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety
nodes.description: Comprehensive safety for construction workers and supervisors. Hazard recognition, avoidance, and prevention.

edges.rationale: Bio-materials and structural knowledge provide the context for industrial welding.
Greywater loop mastery covers the majority of foundational plumbing competencies.
Passive atmospheric management training provides the theoretical basis for professional HVAC safety.
